title: Dashboard summary

stock.reason: use dashboard aggregation concept without importing legacy authority/state assumptions

lessons: worker ok is not semantic success
heavy repair can introduce unavailable dependencies and wrong APIs
deterministic dashboards are pure projections over validated durable state
operator recovery is debt not builder credit

HEPHAESTUS: penalize heavy repair on small deterministic state modules when contract drift occurs
TALOS: verify API shape and canonical corruption boundary independently
KRONOS: first attempt consumed timeout with no useful artifact
RHEA: dashboard reads must not mutate durable state
MYCELIUM: weaken trails from this task shape to current heavy repair route
SWITCHYARD: local/free route retained; no paid escalation
